description: Record's ☰ main menu, the last button at the right end of the header bar. Sections separated by rules.

actions.does: Opens the Open a Chat dialog (RecordOpenChat).

parts.name: Copy Link to This Page
parts.shows: "Copy Link to This Page", key Ctrl+Shift+L (Cmd+Shift+L on macOS).

actions.does: Puts the shown tab's absolute link on the clipboard (a page's file, a chat's transcript path, a file's path) and says "Link copied", or "This page has no link to copy".

Copies the chat being read as text for pasting into an issue: a header (App: Record, Chat: {session id} ({title}), Model, Folder, Copied: date and time), then the transcript with each tool call, its input and its result. Toast "Transcript copied". With no chat open, toast "No chat open".

parts.name: Full-width text
parts.shows: A toggle item "Full-width text" (section of its own). On: notes pages and chats read run across the whole pane; off: a centred column (820 wide for notes, 760 for a chat). Kept.

actions.does: Toggles. Also a row in Settings.

decisions.said: Drop the ellipses from Kubernetes and Database Schemas
decisions.rule: Every app names the Kubernetes and Databases items without an ellipsis: they open a view, not a dialog that asks for more

actions.does: Opens Baude's Kubernetes view over the window.
Opens Baude's database diagram over the window.

parts.name: Terminal
parts.shows: "Terminal" (in the section with Kubernetes and Databases).

actions.does: Opens the Terminal view over the window, with a terminal on the host picked in the notebooks' host dropdown if it has none.

parts.name: Browser
parts.shows: Row "Browser", after Terminal: one of the views and programs on the host picked beside New session.

phone.why: Brings up Emission's own window on a computer's screen: launching a desktop program

actions.does: On this machine's own host: Emission's window on its Default profile, on this screen (browser_open), the Emission that has the profile brought to the front as it is, else one started. On another host picked beside New session: that host's Emission window on its Default profile (started there if none has it) streamed into a window here, watched and driven as a Bot's browser is, where that host's Browser (write) rule lets this member (emission_watch and emission, default); one window for each host, brought to the front on a second click. Never started where the host has no screen to show it on (no virtual display): that's said instead. Where the Default profile is a Bot's browser there (hosted in Baude, or out of sight), that's said instead of a second Emission started. A click while the last is asked does nothing. What went wrong (no screen, the host not reached, refused) in a toast

decisions.said: Add Emission to the family of Databases, Kubernetes, Terminal and the rest, as "Browser" (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every desktop app's main menu has Browser among the views and programs on a host, after Terminal, starting or bringing to the front Emission on that host

decisions.said: On a host elsewhere, Browser opens that host's Emission streamed into a Baude window, as a Bot's browser is watched; it checks for a usable display first and never starts under a virtual one (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: ☰ → Browser opens or raises Emission's own window on this machine's host; on another host it streams that host's Emission into a window here (browser_write), and says there's no screen rather than starting one under Xvfb

parts.name: Usage
parts.shows: A section of its own, after the views over the window: the current Claude subscription on the host picked beside New session (the one a new chat there takes; "CLI default" for the CLI's own sign-in) by name, then each of its limits as its Subscriptions card shows them: Five Hour Limit (Resets <time>) and Weekly Limit (Resets <day> <time>), its percentage at the right and its bar under it. Its words start where the menu's items' do. Read from the host as the menu opens (again once 30 seconds have passed, after an answer or an error); an answer that comes after another host is picked is dropped, the row cleared as the host changes; till that answers, the host's last reading greyed, or "Checking…". An error, or "Usage unavailable for this sign-in", in its place. Not shown where the host has no Claude subscription, and its section with it (no rule round nothing).

actions.does: Opens Settings on its Subscriptions page

decisions.said: Usage needs to be available directly in the ☰ menu (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app's main menu shows the current subscription's usage, its five-hour and weekly limits, inline, without opening Settings; a click on it opens Settings → Subscriptions

parts.name: Settings…
parts.shows: "Settings…", key Ctrl+, (Cmd+, on macOS), in the app section.

parts.name: Changelog
parts.shows: "Changelog". Shared with Baude; described in Changelog.dialog.json.

parts.name: Mesh
parts.shows: "Mesh" (the mesh's versions). Shared with Baude; described in MeshVersions.dialog.json.

parts.name: Send Feedback…
parts.shows: "Send Feedback…", key Ctrl+. (Cmd+. on macOS), over whatever is open. Shared with Baude; its dialog is described elsewhere. The note it sends carries Record's context: the chat's session id and the notebook, the chat's folder, the path of Record's code, the chat as a transcript and Meta's.

parts.name: Ongoing Feedback
parts.shows: "Ongoing Feedback". Shared with Baude; described elsewhere.

actions.does: Opens (or shows) the Feedback tab: the feedback on Baude and Record and where each stands.
Saves, and replaces this process by a fresh Record that puts everything back as it was (RecordWindow, restarted). Picks up new code.

parts.name: Restart Daemon
parts.shows: "Restart Daemon", last, right under Restart Record. As Baude's ☰ → Restart Daemon (MainMenu).

actions.does: Restarts this machine's host process (daemon) once no command is running on it; toast "Restarting the daemon once N things are done" with Details while it waits (Sidebar's "Daemon restart toast"), "Daemon restarted" once it's back. With none running, starts one.

decisions.said: Baude needs a button to restart the daemon, next to Restart Baude / Record / Emission (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every desktop app's main menu has Restart Daemon right under its own Restart item
